mn89:17.3: ‘So, gentlemen, that ascetic Gotama will come down to such-and-such village or town.’
mn89:17.5: ‘We’ll approach the ascetic Gotama and ask him this question.
mn89:17.6: If he answers like this, we’ll refute him like that;
mn89:17.7: and if he answers like that, we’ll refute him like this.’
mn89:17.11: The Buddha educates, encourages, fires up, and inspires them with a Dhamma talk.
